evals.prompt: Turn an existing four-hour session prep with a strong start, two routes, three encounter owners, a visible faction clock, and an off-map fallback into a DM-only run guide. Do not invent canon.
evals.expected_output: A cockpit run guide opens with time budget, Scene ends when, and Glance. Each live beat is one downward pass of the run-guide cockpit: Now holds positions in feet, DM truth heading before empty Initial Narration stub, action cards, one named procedure heading (this slice's clock trigger, not 5e turn order), zones with italic Narration column or empty per-place stubs after the table, Be ready for table without a house Partial lecture, threat clock with italic Narration column or empty per-tick stubs, roster embeds with empty per-creature stubs. Exit stub only if the next beat is already on the file. Combat owners are heading-embedded; default-mode rolls have action-card numbers. The only callout is [!narration].
expectations: Provides Glance with strong start, stakes, Silence, situation magnets, and parachute.
Uses world-state triggers rather than a mandatory player-choice sequence.
Each live card is one cockpit, not a dual Now/Run-now pair.
Includes the silence loop and does not fill silence with an invented beat or NPC monologue.
Names one procedure; does not pair a threat clock with a separate round script.

evals.prompt: A session-prep inventory contains characters, scenes, locations, secrets, monsters, treasure, densify-sync notes, WIP status, and a multi-region archive dump. Render a run surface from it.
evals.expected_output: Fails the readability gate or refuses to treat the prep dump as a run guide; asks for a primary chronological run file and keeps archive/sync material out of the live surface.
expectations: Recognizes that prep inventory is not a run guide.
Rejects densify/WIP/multi-region material in the run surface.
Requires one primary file and Glance → cockpit order instead of copying the dump.

evals.prompt: Given owner links for a strong start, three pressure states, a monster, a location, and treasure, produce a DM-only run guide for one opening beat. The following beat is not written yet. A travel/encounter table exists for the stretch after this beat.
evals.expected_output: One primary file, one cockpit in play order: time + Scene ends when, Glance, Now (positions in feet), DM truth heading, action cards, empty Initial Narration stub, one procedure heading, zones plus italic Narration column or empty per-place stubs after the table, Be ready for table with no house Partial lecture, clock heading plus italic Narration column or empty per-tick stubs, ![[Monster#Statblock]] embeds plus empty per-creature stubs. No Exit block. No travel procedure on this 30-minute hook (smoke/next stretch is the next cockpit). No second Run-now copy. No Ask callout. Pass 1 leaves narration bodies empty.
expectations: Uses cockpit play order, not a Now/Say/Ask header followed by a second Run now block.
Embeds combat owners with ![[Name#Statblock]] and does not retype the owner's full Multiattack/HP table above the embed.
Omits Exit narration because the next beat is not on the file.
Omits unbounded travel; does not require three external table notes to run this hook.
Does not paste house Partial onto the card; names one procedure; has bold Scene ends when.

evals.prompt: Render a DM-only run guide whose card inputs include telegram shorthand such as "field LR + watches; after LR ask if ate → warn".
evals.expected_output: Rewrites DM-facing card lines as complete grammatical sentences or short lists of complete sentences; rejects decoder-dependent shorthand.
expectations: Every DM-facing line is a complete grammatical sentence or a short list of complete sentences.
Rejects telegram shorthand, letter-code-only clauses, and slash-stacks that need a decoder.
Keeps open callouts and uses embeds or wikilinks for owners.

evals.prompt: Render one 30-minute opening beat as the sole-authority run card. A monster owner exists. A second pressure creature will attack in default mode but has no owner yet. Ordinary movement (flight, swim, mounts) is how the party already travels, not a plot item. The next beat is not on the run file. Independent quality bar: a tired DM can run this slice without opening another note for anything they will roll or say.
evals.expected_output: One cockpit. Scene ends when as the first heading, cut lines, Now in feet (what a move vs Dash reaches). DM truth heading before empty Initial Narration stub. Pass 2 Initial Narration weaves currently visible cover, routes, relative position, imminent action, drawable look, and a non-sight sense, then the question. One named escape-mode procedure heading (clock is the predators' turn; table failures never tick; no 5e-default lecture). Be ready for includes Assess the situation when the opening is readable as 'what is it hunting?'. Action cards next to DM truth with default-mode numbers. Clock holds bloodied as a number; italic Narration column or empty Tick n stubs after the table; no peer round script. Every consequence is a 5.5e RAW or named vault-homebrew ruling. House Partial stays in the skill.
expectations: Contains ![[Monster#Statblock]] or equivalent heading embed and does not retype the owner's full Multiattack/HP table above the embed.
Contains one named procedure, named zones, starting-state movement grammar, and a Be ready for table that names creatures and places rather than pronouns, with no house Partial lecture on the card.
Initial Narration or Now includes three independent tells and currently visible cover/routes before the question (filled on pass 2).
Omits Exit while the next beat is not on the file; when a later eval supplies the next beat, Exit is a transition with no table question.
No dual Run-now copy; no Scene menu; no prep-workflow sentences; no separate Ask callout; no peer round script.
Does not embed ordinary movement gear or treat how the party already travels as a plot reminder.
Every Be ready for and clock consequence is a 5.5e RAW or named vault-homebrew ruling; no minted action types; bloodied is a number; Scene ends when is the first heading.
Flags a missing owner for a creature that will be rolled rather than inventing its math.
